title: SAP Digital Manufacturing Lead - Products
description:

You are a senior SAP Manufacturing leader with deep experience designing and delivering SAP Digital Manufacturing, SAP PP, and manufacturing execution solutions. • Provide senior-level oversight for production connector, PCo, OPC, MQTT, API, and equipment integration patterns to enable real-time data capture, operational visibility, and automation.

• Advise clients on SAP ME/MII/legacy MES modernization, cloud MES adoption, global template strategy, multi-plant rollout planning, and sustainable support models.

• Collaborate with project teams, delivery leads, client executives, architects, and Accenture capability leaders to create differentiated SAP Manufacturing offerings and delivery assets.

• Coach and mentor consultants, solution architects, and client teams while maintaining delivery quality, risk management, and alignment to business outcomes.

• Experience leading multiple full-lifecycle SAP Manufacturing or MES implementations in a solution lead, functional lead, architect, or program leadership capacity.

title: FPGA Digital Design Engineer
description:
Our mission is to provide real-time on-orbit connectivity for critical missions, enabling a new era of data-driven intelligence and innovation. With 33 satellites launched to date, Kepler operates the first commercial optical data relay constellation, enabling real-time, continuous space communications while supporting advanced on-orbit compute and hosted payload capabilities. 

We’re on the hunt for a top-tier FPGA Digital Design Engineer to develop the next generation of our satellites.

At Kepler, you’ll have the opportunity to work with a small dedicated team of engineers building the Kepler spacecraft. You will be responsible for the design and implementation of FPGA code either with a focus on DSP algorithms to modulate and demodulate signals on board our software defined radio (SDR), or embedded systems interfacing with processors and peripherals. To be effective you will need to participate in all phases of FPGA design flow (Simulation, Synthesis, Place & Route, Timing Closure and Hardware Testing). A good understanding of the intricacies of FPGA development would make a candidate standout.

Option to work from home (100% remote) available.

Kepler Communications is committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We welcome applications from: Women, Aboriginal persons, persons with disabilities, ethnic minorities, visible minorities, people who identify as LGBTQ+ and others who may contribute to diversification in our workplace.
 
As part of our commitment to accessibility for all persons with disabilities, Kepler will, upon the request of the applicant, provide accommodation during the recruitment process to ensure equal access to applicants with disabilities. Please contact our People & Culture team, through our Career Page to make your accommodation needs known and we will consult with you to ensure suitable accommodation is provided.

title: Life Sciences and Medical Expert (AI Community)
description:

Do you have a background in Medicine, Nursing, or Biology ? AI is being used more and more in healthcare, but it needs experts to make sure the information it gives is safe and accurate. At TELUS Digital , we are looking for people with medical knowledge to check AI-generated health content. You don't need to be a doctor or a tech expert-you just need your medical degree to help the AI "learn" the right facts.
What You’ll Do :

•
Fact-Check Health Info: Read an AI's answer about a medical topic and make sure the facts are 100% correct and up-to-date.

•
Review Medical Terms: Ensure the AI is using the right names for bones, muscles, medicines, or conditions so it sounds professional.

•
Safety First: If the AI gives health advice that seems dangerous or wrong, you flag it immediately to help keep users safe.

•
Explain Simply: Help the AI take complicated medical research and rewrite it in a way that a regular person can understand clearly.

Qualification path
Mandatory Qualifications:

•
Education: A minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Science, Nursing, Biology, Pharmacy , or a related field

•
Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language. Medical terms and health advice change from country to country, so your local knowledge is key.

•
English Proficiency: Basic (B1) English so you can read our project instructions.

•
Attention to Detail: You are careful and realize that in medicine, every small detail matters for safety.

Assessment:
In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.
Payment:
Currently, pay rates for experts range from $20 - $50 USD per hour
Our Payment terms are defined for each project.

•
Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts.

•
Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.

•
Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.

•
Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects.

•

Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Pre-AI SaaS sold tools. AI companies claim they sell outcomes - task done, call answered, lead booked, ticket resolved - but calls or leads aren’t the outcomes that ultimately matter. Our 70-person team (mostly in PDE) spent over a year building in stealth; our thesis is that - if you actually want to control the end result (revenue) of a business and deploy AI fast/cheaply, you can’t just build the sexy part (agents), you must also build the unsexy parts and own everything end to end: the system of record layer and the application layer. We built from scratch every software a home service business needs - replacing ServiceTitan, Squarespace, Ringcentral, Jobber, Square, Hubspot, and a dozen others applications. And we built every agent necessary - AI marketing, AI receptionist, AI voice, AI sales outreach, AI sales coaching, AI follow-ups, AI 3D design, AI finance, AI quoting, AI collections, and more - all embedded inside our own system with native data access. As a result, we can deploy dozens of production-ready Agents to our customers in under 24 hours with no FDEs, no integrations, and no data cleaning work.

We are the most outcome driven business model in the business because we’ve proven our system and AI Agents actually work in driving the end result - revenue. We are not trying to sell our customers a dream - each of our 10+ core AI Agents help improve our customers’ revenue by 5-20%.

title: Internship - Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Smule has been on a mission to bring the world together through music since 2008. Music is much more than listening… it's about creating, sharing, discovering, participating, and connecting with people. With dozens of millions of monthly active users creating over 20 million songs every day, Smule is connecting people all over the world through the joy of making music and transforming the music landscape from one of passive listening to collaborative creative expression and active engagement.
About the Role:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to own the end-to-end lifecycle of ML models in production at Smule, from training and optimization through deployment, monitoring, and iteration. You will work closely with research scientists to bring models off the bench and into scalable, reliable systems that serve millions of users. The ideal candidate is a strong engineer first, with deep practical knowledge of ML systems, a passion for reliability, and an eye for performance.
We strongly encourage candidates with non-traditional backgrounds to apply. If your path into ML engineering came through backend systems, DevOps, audio software, data engineering, or another field, we want to hear from you.
What You'll Be Doing:

• Design, build, and maintain production ML pipelines encompassing data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment.

• Optimize models for production constraints including latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost, using techniques such as quantization, distillation, pruning, and efficient serving architectures.

• Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and observability for deployed models, covering data drift, prediction quality, and system health.

• Collaborate with research scientists to integrate new model architectures and training techniques into production systems with minimal friction.

• Build and improve CI/CD pipelines for ML, including automated testing, validation gates, and staged rollouts.

• Manage compute infrastructure and costs, making informed tradeoffs between performance, reliability, and budget.

What We're Looking For:

• Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or currently pursuing one.

• Strong proficiency in Python and experience with deep learning serving (TorchServe, Triton, vLLM, or equivalent).

• Solid understanding of systems engineering: networking, storage, containerization, orchestration, and monitoring.

• Ability to reason about tradeoffs between latency, throughput, cost, and model quality.

Bonus Points For:

• Experience serving large language models or other generative models at scale.

• Familiarity with audio/music processing pipelines and real-time inference constraints.

• Experience with Bayesian optimization, bandit algorithms, or adaptive experimentation platforms.

• Contributions to open-source ML infrastructure projects.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you'll do

The Release, Environments and Change Engineer (REC Engineer) has three key areas of responsibility. You will operate Release, Environments and Change processes and procedures, and you’ll be involved in, and often lead, the identification and implementation of process improvements using AI and other tools.

You will work closely with the REC Manager and Environments Manager and operate the processes they define. These processes may rely on manual activities and controls at first, so you’ll take a leading role in replacing them with appropriate automation, and then identify mechanisms and methods to govern those automated controls.

You will collaborate with Enablement teams and engineering teams across Kaluza to make sure processes are understood, embedded and followed. You’ll be a decision maker with the authority to decline or postpone releases and changes, and you’ll handle client communication where approval is required for a change or release.

- Operating promotion gates, making promote or block decisions between environments in line with contractual and ways-of-working agreements, and escalating high-risk calls.

- Facilitating change approvals, release Go/No-Go meetings and release trains, preparing releases against readiness criteria and tracking per-team readiness and environment-deployed status.

- Using AI-assisted checks to confirm quality gates are met, summarise what changed in a release, score change risk and flag incomplete or stale records, applying your own judgment to improve the reliability of the results.

- Maintaining complete, accurate change and configuration records, keeping every change traceable across the full environment stack, and managing the change and release calendar.

- Building and maintaining release automation, including readiness checks, artefact promotion, AI-drafted release notes and notifications, and reporting feeds.

- Working with engineering teams in real time to roll back failed releases or apply fixes, and coordinating with incident and problem management so planned changes, hotfixes and major incidents stay in sync.

- Communicating changes and releases internally and externally, supporting environment coordination and validation, running post-implementation reviews and retros, and giving operational input into gate definitions and the wider process.

What you’ll bring 

- Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple moving parts and spot incomplete records or inconsistencies.

- Clear communication and strong facilitation skills, comfortable coordinating across teams, leading check-ins, keeping everyone aligned, driving decisions and chasing things through to completion.

- The confidence to say no and hold the line when something isn’t ready, and to escalate when you’re unsure.

- Comfort with Jira (or similar), including configuring boards, workflows and tickets.

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

You stay current on AI trends and can design interactions that make complex agentic behaviours understandable and controllable for users.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: You have a collaborative approach to product development, working closely with Product Managers to identify opportunities, with Engineers to navigate technical constraints and review implementations, and with stakeholders across the organization to align on solutions.

- User-Centered Approach: You have a deep commitment to understanding user needs through research, data, and direct engagement. You drive research initiatives, translate findings into design decisions, and stay informed on industry trends that shape the product landscape.

- Design Excellence: You have a meticulous attention to craft and detail. You're proficient in Figma, build scalable patterns and systems, and consistently elevate the quality of everything you touch. Bonus points for strong visual design skills in typography, layout, colour, and composition.

- Communication Skills: Clear, proactive communication that keeps distributed teams aligned. You document decisions, articulate design rationale to diverse audiences, and create shared understanding across geographies and disciplines.

description:
INSIDE SALES EXECUTIVE

£60,000-£70,000 OTE (£40,000 base salary + uncapped commission) and a comprehensive benefits package

Location: London office | Office-based, 5 days a week

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy connecting with people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

Help local business owners say yes with confidence, while owning your results and your earning potential.

As an Inside Sales Executive in our Performance Marketing team, you’ll speak with business owners who have already shown interest in Teya. You’ll own the whole journey: qualifying what they need, quoting, closing, and then getting them onboarded and trading as active Members.

This is a high-volume, high-accountability role. Expect around 100-120 calls a day, clear daily targets and uncapped commission. Success is measured by new Members who are live and trading, not just signed.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Work warm leads: Speak with business owners who have come to us through our digital and marketing campaigns.

- Qualify properly: Run structured, consultative conversations. Ask the right questions to understand how each business works, what its challenges are and what will drive the decision.

- Quote and close: Explain our solutions clearly, handle objections professionally and guide business owners to the right decision.

- Onboard and activate: Stay with each new Member through onboarding until they’re up and running, so every deal you close becomes an active Member.

- Own your numbers: Hit your daily activity and monthly targets, and take responsibility for your pipeline.

- Stay organised: Keep accurate CRM records so every opportunity has a clear next step.

title: Founding AE - UK
description: Location: London - hybrid Type: Full-time Level: Senior About Nebuly Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.   Every enterprise function - sales, customer support, HR, finance - is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there - millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents - but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer - is this working, and where - and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value - with no data ever leaving your environment.   Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI - turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We provide the agent engineering platform and open source frameworks developers need to ship reliable agents fast.

title: Freelance Physician Reviewer – Obstetrics and Gynecology Board Preparation
description:
About AMBOSS

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

- Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

- Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

- Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

- Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

- Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

- Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

Qualifications

- Medical degree (MD/DO).

- Current PGY-4 resident or recent graduate of an ACGME-accredited OB-GYN residency program in the U.S.

- Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

- Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

- Ability to provide clear, practical feedback focused on educational value

- Comfortable working independently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines in an asynchronous remote environment

- Preferred (not required): Experience with AI and/or LLM applications

Logistics

- Position type: Freelance, independent contractor (project-based)

- Location: Fully remote

- Duration: 3 months (~5-10 hours/week, as needed)

- Schedule: Flexible and project-based, with agreed-upon turnaround times

- Compensation: $75-$100/hr for current residents; $100-120/hr for recent graduates and attendings

- Start date: As soon as possible

Why join us?

- Use your medical training and board preparation experience to help shape the future of residency education and board preparation.

- Contribute to the quality and responsible use of AI-powered medical education.

- Explore meaningful nonclinical work that complements your clinical training or practice, with flexible, fully remote part-time hours.

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone-regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity-is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care!
